mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_comment (post_id, user_id, content) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT cc.comment_id, cc.post_id, cc.user_id, u.name as userName, cc.content, cc.created_at FROM community_comment cc JOIN user u ON cc.user_id = u.user_id WHERE post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
